description: Start a live timer for the token owner, optionally bound to a task and marked billable. Returns the started entry. Stop it later with `stop_time_entry`.

billable.description: If true, mark the logged time as billable.

description.description: Optional note describing what is being worked on.

tags.description: Array of time-entry tag objects to attach, e.g. [{ name, tag_fg, tag_bg }].

task_id.description: Task id to bind the timer to. Omit for an untied timer.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: start_time_entry
